objective: Reintento valido del dry-run exclusivo ORIGEN 2026-10-15. Runtime/base correcto: 34743.49, 23 tickets, 60 PAX. Detalle persistido incompleto: 12018.50, 13 tickets, 22 PAX. Evaluar si el backfill independiente puede reconstruir el faltante y conciliar exactamente, sin modificar datos. No tocar sincronizadores protegidos ni Produccion.

queries.name: origen_oct15_pre_backfill_parity
queries.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT numero_ticket,SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(importe_neto,0) ELSE 0 END) AS venta_ticket,MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 AND ISNULL(cancelado_origen,0)=0 THEN ISNULL(pax,0) ELSE 0 END) AS pax_ticket FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-15' GROUP BY numero_ticket), ds AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(venta_ticket) AS decimal(18,2)) AS detalle_ventas,COUNT(*) AS detalle_tickets,SUM(pax_ticket) AS detalle_pax FROM d), r AS (SELECT TOP 1 CAST(ventas_total AS decimal(18,2)) AS runtime_ventas,tickets_total AS runtime_tickets,pax_total AS runtime_pax FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='ORIGEN' AND fecha_operacion='2026-10-15') SELECT ds.detalle_ventas,ds.detalle_tickets,ds.detalle_pax,r.runtime_ventas,r.runtime_tickets,r.runtime_pax,CAST(ds.detalle_ventas-r.runtime_ventas AS decimal(18,2)) AS delta_ventas,ds.detalle_tickets-r.runtime_tickets AS delta_tickets,ds.detalle_pax-r.runtime_pax AS delta_pax FROM ds CROSS JOIN r
